summary: Completed Module 06 VERIFY step demonstrating deep understanding of cache invalidation complexity, auth-protected caching vulnerabilities, and graceful degradation during cache outages.
evidence: Articulated why cache invalidation is hard: distributed writes across disparate systems, race conditions between writes and reads, and stale data risks mitigated by DB-first updates and TTLs.
Identified critical security risks in caching auth-protected data: cross-tenant data leakage if cache keys lack tenant scoping, and authorization bypass if cached records skip permission checks.
Defined system behavior during Redis outages: graceful degradation falling back to PostgreSQL with structured warning logs, preserving redirect availability.
